EXT.WEIL.locator: Published equation (1.2); matching multiplicative-character bound in Section 1, page 1 of the author version dated April 19, 2001
EXT.WEIL.scope: For a prime p, a nonprincipal multiplicative character of F_p extended by zero, and a polynomial f of degree d>=1 with d distinct zeros in an algebraic closure, the norm of sum_{z in F_p} psi(f(z)) is at most (d-1)*sqrt(p). No condition p not dividing d is imposed.
EXT.WEIL.status: Trusted literature input; exact simple-root prime-field interface registered
EXT.WEIL.trust: The cited univariate Weil estimate is assumed under the author-approved source-relative scope. The projective-line deductions are proved independently from this interface.
EXT.WEIL.interface_status: Registered; inspection in the verification report
EXT.WEIL.lean_statement: For p : Nat with Fact p.Prime, psi : MulChar (ZMod p) Complex with psi != 1, f : Polynomial (ZMod p) with 0 < f.natDegree and Fintype.card (f.rootSet (AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p))) = f.natDegree, norm (sum z : ZMod p, psi (f.eval z)) <= (f.natDegree - 1 : Real) * Real.sqrt p.
